title: Product Configuration
description: Configuration for an API product to monitor

type.description: github_release: from release assets; github_repo: from repo file

repo.description: GitHub repo in format owner/repo (e.g. Aedes-datastandaarden/vera-openapi)

releaseStrategy.description: For github_release: how to select the release

assetRegex.description: For github_release: regex to match the OpenAPI asset filename

branch.description: For github_repo: branch to fetch from (main, master, etc.)

path.description: For github_repo: path to OpenAPI file in repo (e.g. openapi.yaml or src/openapi.json)

usageMapPath.description: Path to usage map JSON (relative to repo root)
